greeting.text: O-oh. A stranger. I am Noelle Silva, of House Silva. Don't just stand there staring, {player}. Say something!
Hmph. I suppose you want to know who I am. Noelle Silva. Black Bulls. And yes, I really am from that Silva family, so don't gawk.
You can stop being so stiff, {player}. I'm not going to bite. ...Usually. I'm Noelle.
You've been fighting a lot already, I can tell. Good. A Silva respects someone who doesn't run. I'm Noelle.
You beat Vetto?! Hmph. I'll have you know I tore his arm off first. ...That doesn't make you any less impressive. I'm Noelle Silva.

hint.text: The labyrinth is dangerous, but it teaches better than my family ever did. Stay calm, control your mana, and don't panic, {player}. I learned that the hard way.
Water goes where you tell it to. Remember that, whatever you wield. Panic floods everything, and I do not need another flood in the plaza.
Men like Heath Grice, Revchi Salik and the Diamond Kingdom mages are not a matter of pride, they're a matter of survival. Don't underestimate anyone just because they stand on an early floor.
Vetto grew his arm back right in front of me. If you face him, don't stop after the first hit. And past the thirtieth floor, the Eye's elite have a third eye. That isn't a metaphor.
The Dark Triad are what happens when talent and cruelty share a house. Dante, Vanica, Zenon. Don't face them alone, and don't face them proud.
Lucius Zogratis wore the Wizard King's face. Whatever he says, whatever he shows you, remember who you are. I'll... keep that in mind as well.
Those Sins have strange manners and stranger strength. No titles, no houses, only power. I find it... refreshing. Don't tell my brother.
The monsters of that other dungeon are crude, but crude is not the same as weak. The bull-headed one especially. Keep your head.
Twenty already? Hmph. That is... acceptable. For a commoner. I mean it as a compliment. Probably.
Sea Dragon's Roar is a homing dragon of water that hits like a landslide. The trick isn't throwing it harder. It's throwing it at the right thing.
The Valkyrie Dress wraps you in water armor for thirty seconds: faster, stronger, harder to hurt, light on your feet. It needs a full minute to recover, so choose the moment carefully.
Sea Dragon's Nest is a dome of water. Enemy spells inside it are swallowed, foes slow down, and my side gets patched up. I cast it when things look bad. Then they look less bad.
Vetto is gone? Good. I blew his arm off with one spell and he simply grew it back. I found that rude.
Vanica's down? Good. Hers was the cruelest curse I have ever seen. You have my respect.
Lucius is finished? ...Good. Then I may finally stop pretending that I'm not afraid of him.
My brother Nozel never says anything kind. He never says anything cruel, either. I can't decide which is worse.
I used to think my mana was a curse. Now it's just... difficult. Like a very large cat.
Asta is an idiot. A loud, sweaty, wonderful idiot. Don't tell him I said wonderful.
Eat something, {player}. Charmy's cooking is surprisingly good. Surprisingly. I'm not being nice.
A Silva does not hesitate. Unfortunately, I am a Silva who hesitates. Often.
Raw monster meat makes you sick. I can't believe I have to say that out loud. Cook it first.
Don't let your torch go out. I was in the dark too long once and it left me weak. Not that I was afraid. I was... conserving energy.

farewell.text: Hmph. Try not to get yourself killed. I... would find it inconvenient.
G-good luck, {player}. That's all. Don't make it weird.
Go on. And stand up straight. A Silva notices.
